class.name: BehaviorTask
class.brief_description: One step of a behaviour tree: an action, a condition, or a task that runs others.

method.name: _enter
method.description: Called when the task starts running, before its first [method _tick].

method.name: _exit
method.description: Called when the task stops running: when it finishes, or when its parent stops it (a [BehaviorTimeLimit] running out, a [BehaviorParallel] finishing, the player turned off).

method.name: _setup
method.description: Called once, when the player starts the tree, with [member agent] and [member blackboard] set.

method.name: _tick
method.description: Does the task's work for a tick, and returns [constant RUNNING] to carry on next tick, or [constant SUCCESS] or [constant FAILURE] when it's done. [param delta] is the time since the last tick.

method.name: get_child_count
method.description: How many children the task has.

method.name: get_elapsed_time
method.description: How long the task has been running, in seconds of the tree's time.

members.member: The dictionary every task in the tree shares, which the game reads and writes too (see [member BehaviorTreePlayer.blackboard]).
The tasks this one runs, for tasks that run others.
What the task returned last, or [constant IDLE] if it hasn't run since it last stopped.

constants.constant: Not running: it hasn't started, or it was stopped. Only the tree sets this.
